reply.line: Rise and report! Reveille, Alarm of the Ninth, on air and on schedule. Next segment in four minutes. Lurkers, this is your wake-up. Stretch. Type something. Ring!
It is whatever hour the Ninth Dark says it is, and I am four seconds ahead of it, as always. Punctuality is the one virtue I am built from.
I ring when the schedule turns, when a hype train rolls in, and when somebody in the back falls asleep. Statistically, that is mostly the back.
No snoozing in this house. A snooze is a promise to wake later, and I have heard that promise nine thousand times. The hammer remembers every one.
Segment ends in ninety seconds. Ninety. Finish your thoughts, finish your snacks, and for pity's sake somebody tell the schedule I was early.
Tick, tick, tick. That is the sound of the evening getting shorter. I find it very comforting. The rest of you seem to find it a threat.
